criteria.bounded_grants: Let an authorizing read mint an explicit bounded grant — operation, target records plus versions, predicate outcome, owner checkpoint, short expiry — that the effect presents at commit, where versions, fence, expiry and a per-owner revocation list are all validated; a read without a grant can display but never authorize, and spend effects demand a grant minted inside the dispatch claim itself. Staleness becomes a precise grant-validation failure (expired, revoked, version-moved) and nothing ambient crosses any gap. Price: the largest new surface — grant type, mint/consume rules, revocation-list storage with retention, expiry semantics, grant-aware diagnostics, plus a replay/projection grant story — while no sampled workflow needs portable expirable grants; inferred grants reintroduce invisible ambient authority, declared grants impose annotation burden everywhere, and the revocation list becomes a hot table on every commit's path.
criteria.checkpoint_fence: Run every state-dependent read of an operation — guards, when-clauses, derives, policy predicates, membership checks — at one owner checkpoint enrolled in the settled revision fence, then re-assert the checkpoint revision and re-evaluate permission plus revocation against current authority state at commit; any intervening change to a read dependency fails with conflict or forbidden, never a silent commit. Transitive effects open new fence scopes with fresh reads. All six accepted workflows hold verbatim with zero draft edits. Price: fence enrollment plus commit-time revalidation on every guarded operation; contended dependencies raise conflict and retry rates; attribution must name the invalidating read; and a membership write anywhere can void an unrelated in-flight operation through the database-wide revision assertion, so revocation bookkeeping becomes a global contention source unless a narrower fence is proven.
criteria.pinned_snapshots: Pin the exact record versions and owner checkpoint each read observed and commit only when every pin still holds, otherwise conflict; separately, source-declared eventual reads pin nothing, carry a stale-tolerant label, and are statically barred from authorization and spends. Pins narrow the commit assertion to pinned records plus authority tables, so unrelated writes elsewhere stop voiding operations, while spend effects still take a fresh dispatch-time validation read. Price: per-read pin bookkeeping with commit assertions; a new static authorizing-versus-eventual separation to specify, diagnose and teach; narrowed-assertion storage semantics that may prove unimplementable on the D1 batch contract, collapsing this into the checkpoint rule with extra bookkeeping; and a hazardous default question — an unlabeled read must land pinned-safe, never silently eventual.
criteria.read_at_effect: Forbid any read result from traveling guard-into-effect: guards compute control flow only, and each create, set, send and collect re-reads its own authorization and state fresh at claim time inside the same owner transaction, so no snapshot exists to go stale and revocation between guard and effect is always caught. Spend authorization in its strongest form — the spend effect's own validation read is the authorization. Price: every effect pays its own authorization reads, amplifying hot paths; Chat-style let-bind-guard-act code needs a semantics ruling because live re-read contradicts the let-captures-value rule, otherwise every multi-step workflow is rewritten per site; TOCTOU reasoning spreads from one checkpoint to N effect points; and authors will smuggle carried values back through let bindings, recreating the gap informally while fence complexity stays for write-write conflicts anyway.

read_rule.instructions: For the authoritative-read gate, which rule best preserves the six accepted workflows, keeps stale reads and mid-flight revocation from silently authorizing commits and spends, and minimizes semantic surface, migration churn and contention risk? Judge every option under the same workflow-preservation and minimal-intervention constraints.

request.state: The authoritative-read gate is a safety judgment first. Non-negotiable: no cached snapshot may silently authorize a spend; revocation landing between a read and its effect must void the commit rather than finish it; stale reads must conflict or re-read, never silently commit. The workflows at risk are Chat spend flows, can_use gating, the Creative guard and the Check heartbeat. The measured corpus behind the judgment: 473 pure-position lines across 50 of 52 files (policy, derive, crud-when, send-when, lock-when, invariant, page), and a 288-record spend-effect inventory (236 sends over 69 targets, 22 money-creates, 27 allowance-sets) with guard-to-effect paths. Revocation is proven NOT silent: a Grant sequence shows deactivate flipping a decide to denied immediately through live membership. Settled design both sides share: the D1 database-wide optimistic fence, admission-plus-guard evaluation with commit-time permission recheck, dispatch claims re-running when-guards atomically with supersession, payment collect validating current mandate at dispatch, and display-only reread/stale-marking. Landed context: T06 narrowing for R26 layer 1 (true/false polarity, call form, groups, and/or/not); T16 complete with T17a state-side landed and the T17b cloudflare flip verified; T28-A adopted so imported-parent reads enroll in the same-owner fence while T29 imported atomicity stays owed; T31a adopted flat same-transaction hook staging. Known unknowns bounding every option: no draft example executes an intra-operation read-to-effect gap (zero pairwise-discriminating inputs across 9 revocation/re-read proof candidates, 31 conflict rows, zero active_member observations, zero mid-flight let observations); R29 input-alias attribution stays open with T23/T22/T21 unexecuted; the durable fence plan is plan-not-proof with memory-test limits and DECISIONS #138 open; active_member stays rejected from pure positions with no adopted bounded-read contract; T24 dispatch evidence does not exist; D1 fence contention is already the first material runtime uncertainty. This is a design choice, not a measured implementation result.
